notes.title: Unity bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a Unity bug that caused some platforms to not be considered "the ground" by the player's collision logic, and thus made some levels unbeatable.

notes.title: No one will ever read this, but here's a small patch
notes.content: Adjusted ground-detection logic for Jeremy and Alex. This should prevent them from entering their fall animations when standing at the veeeeeeery edge of a platform.
